population.intervention: Physiotherapy informed by Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (PACT) combined with dynamic neuromuscular stabilization (DNS)-based graded exercise.
population.intervention_regimen: Six once-weekly 45 min sessions over six weeks (planned); structured PACT treatment manual with ACT processes and graded DNS-based exercise.
population.population_definition: Randomized allocation to PACT; final analyzed sample.; Adults aged ≥18 years with non-specific chronic low back pain (duration longer than 12 weeks), recruited at University Hospital Brno between September 2022 and April 2024, randomized to PACT, and included in the final analyzed sample (n=25). Exclusions: specific lumbar spine pathology (e.g., fracture, cancer), deteriorating neurological signs, injection therapy within 3 months, current alcohol or drug misuse, prior cognitive-behavioral therapy or pain management at any time, other physiotherapy treatment in the previous 6 months, and current psychiatric illness.
population.population_time_frame: Recruitment September 2022–April 2024; baseline before the first therapy session; post-intervention at week 6.

population.intervention: Usual physiotherapy care: individualized graded therapeutic exercise based on the DNS concept plus manual therapy consisting of post-isometric relaxation (PIR) and myofascial release.
population.intervention_regimen: Six once-weekly 45 min sessions over six weeks (planned); each session included a brief functional assessment (~5–10 min), main exercise segment (~25–30 min), and manual therapy (~10 min).
population.population_definition: Randomized allocation to usual care; final analyzed sample.; Adults aged ≥18 years with non-specific chronic low back pain (duration longer than 12 weeks), recruited at University Hospital Brno between September 2022 and April 2024, randomized to usual physiotherapy care, and included in the final analyzed sample (n=25). Exclusions: specific lumbar spine pathology (e.g., fracture, cancer), deteriorating neurological signs, injection therapy within 3 months, current alcohol or drug misuse, prior cognitive-behavioral therapy or pain management at any time, other physiotherapy treatment in the previous 6 months, and current psychiatric illness.
population.population_time_frame: Recruitment September 2022–April 2024; baseline before the first therapy session; post-intervention at week 6.

population.intervention: Physiotherapy informed by Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (PACT) combined with dynamic neuromuscular stabilization (DNS)-based graded exercise; or usual care (UC) with individualized DNS-based graded exercise and manual therapy. Both trial interventions are represented.
population.intervention_regimen: Both groups planned six once-weekly 45 min sessions over six weeks; this population describes the initial sample before the four post-first-session exclusions.
population.population_definition: Enrolment and treatment initiation before exclusion; combined across both trial intervention groups.; Adults aged ≥18 years with non-specific chronic low back pain lasting longer than 12 weeks, under physician care at Brno University Hospital and enrolled in the trial; exclusions include specific lumbar spine pathology (e.g. fracture, cancer), deteriorating neurological signs, injection therapy within 3 months, current alcohol or drug misuse, prior cognitive-behavioral therapy or pain-management treatment at any time, other physiotherapy in the previous 6 months, and current psychiatric illness. Includes the four participants excluded after the first session.
population.population_time_frame: Recruitment September 2022–April 2024; baseline before the first therapy session.

population.intervention: Physiotherapy informed by Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (PACT) combined with DNS-based graded exercise, or usual physiotherapy care with DNS-based graded exercise and manual therapy (post-isometric relaxation and myofascial release).
population.intervention_regimen: Both groups: six once-weekly 45 min sessions over six weeks (planned).
population.population_definition: Final analysis set after post-first-session exclusions; combined across randomized PACT and UC groups.; Adults aged ≥18 years with non-specific chronic low back pain lasting >12 weeks; randomized to PACT or UC; retained in the final analyzed sample after four participants were excluded after the first session for difficulties comprehending/engaging with the intervention.
population.population_time_frame: Recruitment September 2022–April 2024; baseline before the first therapy session; post-intervention at week 6.
